job: Read what one provider offers, try a capability, and add a ready-made skill.
purpose: A provider page: a header with its category and a suggested ask, a playground to try a capability with its fields, request and code, the list of capabilities with their price, ready-made skills to copy, and the pricing and terms. Capabilities and skills load and fail on their own; a provider whose terms are not accepted offers Review and accept, and an unknown one says so.
useWhen: A person has picked a provider and needs to try it and decide whether to use it.
Terms and pricing are part of the decision.

avoidWhen.when: The person is still comparing many providers.
The person wants the agent to choose the calls.

states.name: ready
states.how: the default after a short load

states.name: loading
states.how: ?state=loading: skeleton lists under Capabilities and Ready-made skills

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error: capabilities and skills each show a danger fd-empty with Retry; the playground stays

states.name: terms
states.how: ?state=terms: the playground is replaced by Accept the terms

states.name: not-found
states.how: ?state=not-found: only the back link and Browse the catalog
